title: Algorithmic Yield Cartel and Single-Family REO Securitization Bundle
description: Locked constant and output validation surface for SPEC-ALGORITHMIC-YIELD-CARTEL-AND-SINGLE-FAMILY-REO-SECURITIZATION-v1.0. Covers the hub-and-spoke inelasticity-driven markup identity under 15 U.S.C. Sec. 1, the artificial-vacancy NOI rent-extraction wedge, the single-family REO securitization maintenance-stripping settlement predicate, the Milkovich H0 revealed-preference falsification gate, and the Clayton Act Sec. 4 mandatory treble disgorgement identity.

hub_and_spoke_collusion.description: Hub-and-spoke algorithmic collusion block (15 U.S.C. Sec. 1; United States et al. v. RealPage, Inc., M.D.N.C. Case No. 1:24-cv-00710). Identities: mu_cartel = -(v_cartel - v_comp) / eps_shelter; R_cartel = R_comp * (1 + mu_cartel); o = 1 - v.

competitive_market_vacancy_rate.description: Competitive market-clearing vacancy baseline v_comp (fraction, 2.5 percent frictionally empty units).

cartel_artificial_vacancy_rate.description: Engineered artificial vacancy equilibrium v_cartel (fraction, 6.5 percent; 4.0 percentage points of supply deliberately withheld).

inelastic_shelter_demand_elasticity.description: Constant-elasticity shelter demand eps_shelter; strictly negative and inelastic (|eps| < 1) because housing is non-deferrable.

cartel_markup_over_competitive_rent.description: Collusive rent markup mu_cartel = -(v_cartel - v_comp) / eps_shelter = -(0.065 - 0.025) / -0.25 = 0.16 (16.0 percent).

competitive_monthly_rent_usd.description: Competitive market-clearing monthly rent R_comp per unit (USD).

cartel_collusive_monthly_rent_usd.description: Collusive monthly rent R_cartel = R_comp * (1 + mu_cartel) = 2000.0 * 1.16 per unit (USD).

artificial_vacancy_noi.description: Artificial-vacancy NOI identity block. Identities: E_comp = R_comp * o_comp; E_cartel = R_cartel * o_cartel; Delta_NOI = E_cartel - E_comp. The cartel rents fewer units yet collects more revenue: the wedge is pure rent extraction against inelastic demand.

competitive_expected_revenue_per_unit_us.description: Competitive expected monthly revenue per door E_comp = 2000.0 * 0.975 (USD).

cartel_expected_revenue_per_unit_usd.description: Cartel expected monthly revenue per door E_cartel = 2320.0 * 0.935 (USD).

net_collusive_noi_gain_per_unit_monthly_.description: Pure rent-extraction wedge Delta_NOI = E_cartel - E_comp = 2169.2 - 1950.0 per unit per month (USD); intentionally vacant units also accrue reduced physical wear-and-tear.

reo_securitization_maintenance_stripping.description: Single-family REO securitization and maintenance-stripping block (FTC v. Invitation Homes Inc., N.D. Ga. Case No. 1:24-cv-04252; City of Redondo Beach ex rel. Deckard Technologies v. Invitation Homes Inc., 9th Cir. False Claims Act unpermitted-renovation qui tam). NOI-keyed securitization converts deferred habitability maintenance and junk fees into rated bond yield.

ftc_invitation_homes_settlement_usd_mill.description: FTC junk-fee and maintenance-withholding settlement against the largest single-family REO operator (USD millions; 48,000,000.00 USD).

clayton_treble_liquidation.description: Clayton Act Sec. 4 (15 U.S.C. Sec. 15) mandatory treble disgorgement block. Identity: L_treble = round(Delta_NOI * 12 * 3, 4) per unit per year, plus cost of suit and reasonable attorney's fee.

clayton_act_treble_disgorgement_per_unit.description: Mandatory treble disgorgement L_treble = round(219.2 * 12 * 3, 4) per unit per year (USD); annual single damages are 219.2 * 12 = 2630.40 USD.

h0_falsification.description: Milkovich H0 versus H1 falsification gate (Milkovich v. Lorain Journal Co., 497 U.S. 1; Partington v. Bugliosi, 56 F.3d 1147). H0 (non-binding decision support) predicts zero deviation cost and convergence of observed vacancy to v_comp; the sustained divergence v_cartel - v_comp = 0.040 across the pooled cohort, enforced by private-data pooling plus auto-accept discipline, falsifies H0 by revealed preference. The identity residual mu*eps + Delta_v closes to zero.

h0_falsified.description: True when sustained v_cartel > v_comp across all pooled competitors, incompatible with non-binding advisory pricing.

identity_residual_zero.description: True when mu_cartel * eps_shelter + (v_cartel - v_comp) == 0, confirming the markup is fully attributable to coordinated withholding.
